page_title: Whimsical — The whiteboard for product builders

sources.entry: Whimsical - All-in-one workspace for fast-paced teams. #freemium

summary.name: Whimsical
summary.one_liner: Whimsical is a collaborative whiteboard for product teams to create diagrams, flowcharts, mind maps, and wireframes.
use_cases: Brainstorming and organizing ideas with a team
Creating mind maps to refine a solution
summary.what_it_does: Whimsical provides an infinite canvas where teams can build diagrams, flowcharts, and mind maps. It includes a drag-and-drop wireframe editor for shaping UI ideas. Multiple people can edit boards in real time, and comments are attached to the work itself. An AI feature generates diagrams, brainstorms ideas, and organizes information. The page also mentions a template library, image and video embeds (Loom, YouTube), and version history to restore earlier board states.
notable: Combines diagramming, flowcharts, mind maps and wireframes in one canvas
Whimsical AI generates diagrams and brainstorms ideas
Real-time multiplayer editing with in-board comments
Version history to restore earlier board states
caveats: Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; freemium is taken from the listing
Platforms beyond the web app are not named on the page
